citation: Lab case (not a paper): Pharos 1030 nm / 200 fs / 1 kHz laser, multi-pass cell with a 5 mm fused-silica plate, SEQUOIA third-order cross-correlator. The owner's recordings of 2026-10 (data/).
topic: MPC spectral broadening and temporal contrast of a Pharos laser measured with a third-order cross-correlator

referenceNumbers.value: Spectrum_Pharos_Output.csv = seed spectrum (8.5 nm FWHM); Spectrum_Pharos{10,20,30,39}%.csv = broadened spectra (50-120 nm) treated as the cell output at those Pharos levels (the owner's description called them seed spectra; their width says otherwise: to be confirmed); Contrast_Pharos_NarrowbandNF.dat = SEQUOIA of the seed; Contrast_Pharos20%_No_MPC_Ep_34_6uJ.dat = SEQUOIA with the cell bypassed (detector floor ~1e-7); Varying_Pharos_Pulse_Energies/*.dat = SEQUOIA behind the cell, powers (mW at 1 kHz) in the file names

200 fs, 1 kHz, 1030 nm; MPC: 50 passes, length 1350 mm, ROC ~2 m (not exactly known), 5 mm fused-silica plate 200 mm from a mirror, beam radius ~0.55 mm (constant when matched), dispersive mirrors (GDD per bounce unknown); then QWP - HWP - Glan polariser; then SEQUOIA
referenceNumbers.status: stated by the owner, not measured here

assumptions: Pulse energy at the cell: the power meter readings in the file names of the SEQUOIA traces (10.1, 18.5, 21.2, 26.7 mW at 1 kHz for the 10, 20, 30, 39 % spectra), assumed to be at the cell input.
1-D plane-wave, single polarisation (scalar Kerr + silica Raman); the QWP / HWP / polariser state, and so any nonlinear ellipse rotation, is not modelled. Air Kerr is not included.

The cell is reduced to 5 blocks (fast) or 25 blocks (full) of the 50 plate passes; dispersive-mirror GDD is lumped in the middle of the cell and fitted; the Kerr strength is fitted as an energy scale (equivalent to an unknown beam radius).
Plate ghosts (reflectance per face, scaled with the passes per block so the coherent ghost amplitude is that of the passes) are a scan, not a fit: the coating is unknown.
The measured seed trace is the input pedestal (kind measured, |t| > 1.5 ps); the SEQUOIA response is part of that trace.
HITRAN H2O lines (downloaded at run time, never stored in the repository): 67.5 m of air at 22 C, 45 % humidity behind the cell, delayed light on a 2 ns tail grid; skipped when offline.
